rule.name: LogPlaceholderSlip
rule.message: This SLF4J or Log4j 2 message loses an argument. With one curly-brace placeholder for every argument and the exception last, the exception is printed with toString() and its stack trace is never logged; and %s, %d or a numbered placeholder in a logger that reads curly braces is printed as it stands while its argument is dropped. Write one curly-brace pair for each value except the exception, which goes last with no pair of its own (log.warn("Failed for", id, e) plus the pair after for), and use the pair instead of %s or %d. An exception fits when only the exception text is wanted in the message: pass e.getMessage().
